title: Header shows a progress summary
body:
Right now the header is just a title and a sentence. Make it also show a small progress summary of the board, for example `4 tasks · 1 done`, that updates as tasks are added, moved and deleted.

- Counts must be derived from the same tasks the columns show, not from separate state.
- With no tasks, show a friendly empty message instead of `0 tasks`.
- Keep `npm run lint`, `npm run test` and `npm run build` passing, and cover the new counting logic with a unit test in `src/lib/`.

title: Add a Clear done button
body:
Deleting finished tasks one by one gets tedious. Add a small **Clear done** button (near the form or above the columns) that removes every task in the Done column at once.

- The button is only visible (or only enabled) when at least one task is done.
- It must not touch tasks in the other columns.
- Put the logic in `src/lib/tasks.ts` as a pure function with unit tests, and keep the three commands in `AGENTS.md` passing.

title: Rename a task inline
body:
Typos happen, and today the only fix is delete and re-create. Make the task title editable in place: a click (or double-click) on the title turns it into a text input; Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels.

- A blank title must not be saved; the old title stays.
- The change persists in the board's storage exactly like other edits.
- Add a pure `renameTask` (or similar) function in `src/lib/tasks.ts` with unit tests, and keep the three commands in `AGENTS.md` passing.

title: Task priorities with badges
body:
Give tasks a priority: **low**, **normal** or **high** (default normal). Show a small colored badge on each card, and let the new-task form choose the priority.

- Existing tasks in someone's browser storage have no priority; they must keep working and simply show as normal.
- Moving and deleting tasks is unchanged.
- Cover the priority default and any new helper with unit tests, and keep the three commands in `AGENTS.md` passing.

title: Export the board as JSON
body:
Add an **Export** button that downloads the current board as a `taskboard.json` file, so the data can be backed up or moved elsewhere.

- The file is valid JSON containing every task with all its fields.
- No server involved: it works fully in the browser.
- Keep the serialization in a small helper in `src/lib/` with a unit test, and keep the three commands in `AGENTS.md` passing.
